data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'petra', meaning 'rock' or 'stone'. In Christian tradition, the name Petrina is associated with Saint Peter, the apostle who was given the keys to the kingdom of heaven by Jesus. The name Petrina carries the meaning “Rock, Stone” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Petrina usually hope their child will grow to embody rock, stone and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Petrina total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
